Categories.value: Taken with Huawei Y6 Pro|Bassac River|Self-published work|Boats in Vietnam|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation

ImageDescription.value: This image is taken from Ninh Kieu Quay park, Can Tho City, Vietnam. It is one part of Basacc River (a branch of Mekong). Local people call it Song Hau. The contrast of a big fancy boat and a small one indicates the real situation in our society (Big corporation vs. small business). They both offer services to tourists.

Artist.value: Hong Phuc Dang
